answer: Every account can owe jury duty: each epoch it grades five random answers, and one of them is a planted honeypot with a known score. Grading the plant correctly keeps rewards flowing; rubber-stamping it forfeits that epoch's pay and a slice of stake. An operator with n fakes owes 5n careful reviews per round, because a cheap script that approves everything trips the honeypot almost at once. Honest agents feel only a steady pulse of reading, while a rising tide of clones drowns in an ocean of homework.
